name: Steam Generator Tube Rupture
description: A tube in steam generator 1 fails, so reactor coolant leaks into its secondary side. Primary pressure and pressurizer level fall while SG-1 level and pressure rise abnormally; the reactor trips and safety injection actuates. The affected steam generator now holds contaminated water and must be identified and isolated, and primary pressure lowered to stop the leak.
briefing: At t+30 s a tube ruptures in SG-1. Diagnose it: which steam generator is filling on its own while primary pressure and pressurizer level fall? The plant trips as SG-1 overfills. The mitigation is to reduce primary pressure toward the ruptured SG's pressure so the leak stops - then keep that SG isolated because its steam is contaminated.
learning_objectives: Recognise a tube rupture from a diverging primary/secondary inventory picture
Identify the affected steam generator (abnormal level and pressure rise)
Manage the trip and watch pressurizer level and safeguards status
Understand that primary depressurisation, not more injection, stops the leak
